newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel to visit Chicago's CME Thursday.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel to visit Chicago's CME Thursday.

text.p: Finance Minister Trevor Manuel would meet Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) officials on Thursday ahead of the launch of its dollar/rand futures and options next week, the exchange said in a statement.
Manuel, accompanied by Finance director general Maria Ramos, would be the guest of honour of the CME's executive officers, the CME said.
The rand contracts, which begin trading on May 7, will be sized at 500,000 rand and quoted in dollars per rand.
The South African Futures Exchange (Safex) is to launch an inverse rand/dollar contract on the same day.
Safex planned to launch its products this Wednesday, but announced a postponement late on Tuesday to coincide with the CME launch.
